purpose: Teach: 西川/横山/藤本/新田/飯田/西尾/木下/秋山

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の西川刑事のご活躍も評価されますね
lines.en: The detective work of Nishikawa from the station is certainly being recognized.
lines.style: Measured, respectful tone. Steady pacing. Acknowledgment that carries weight without flattery. Slight formal register—speaking about institutional competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者横山氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: The police are being thoughtful about the victim Yokoyama's family as well.
lines.style: Gentle shift—softer attack on this line. Sincere, not performative. Pace slows slightly to honor the mention of family. Warm undertone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人藤本氏から、警察、事情を丁寧に伺われますね
lines.en: The police are listening carefully to witness Fujimoto's account.
lines.style: Deliberate, even tone. Emphasis on 'carefully'—a small nod to the care being taken. Professional but not cold. Steady eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新田巡査の現場対応を、警察、ご指導されますね
lines.en: Officer Nitta's response at the scene is being guided well.
lines.style: Slight lift in energy—acknowledging good fieldwork. Approving tone without condescension. Light, clean delivery. Brief pause before moving to the next point.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、飯田課長の捜査指揮を、警察、信頼されますね
lines.en: Chief Iida's investigation is being trusted and supported.
lines.style: Firm, grounded tone. This carries confidence—a statement of trust. Even pacing. No hesitation. The weight of institutional backing is in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、広報の西尾様が記者対応をされますね
lines.en: Nishio from public relations is handling media inquiries.
lines.style: Straightforward, neutral delivery. Matter-of-fact acknowledgment of a necessary role. No emphasis—just stating the fact. Steady, professional tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察犬訓練の木下さんと連携されますね
lines.en: The dog unit training under Kinoshita is being coordinated with.
lines.style: Practical, forward-moving tone. Acknowledges coordination without drama. Light, connected pacing—listing a tactical element. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、鑑識の秋山主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: Chief Akiyama from forensics is conducting the scene examination.
lines.style: Respectful, grounded final note. Slight warmth—this is the closing acknowledgment. Steady pace slowing just at the end. Authority and competence in equal measure.
